text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text: "So delicioooous!!!"

text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text:
"This ramen is insane!" "Isn't this way 
too luxurious?" "And the broth! I feel 
like I could drink this forever!" "Coming 
here on an empty stomach was totally worth 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Male Fan A
text_block_list.text:
To think I get to eat something this 
delicious... It's the best! In fact, it's 
almost too good!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so... to make up for the treat, I 
wanna keep cheering you on with everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Was I able to repay your kindness, even 
just a little?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes. I believe we did our absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
For the best... indeed. Expanding the 
scale did cause some delays at times.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, in the middle of all that... I was 
able to do my best. Maybe that's something 
I can take pride in!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. So, from here on... just one more 
step. Let's aim beyond our best and do our 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We need to get ready right away! For 
our "seconds"!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Helllooo, everyone! Were you able to enjoy 
some delicious ramen?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Are you full already? —Don't you want... 
seconds?"

text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text:
"What's this?" "Hello-san?" "Seconds?!" 
"There's another kind of ramen?" "I'm 
full, but..." "Since we're here, why not!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, please take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—I'm running a race. Get here as fast as 
you can to watch.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's not just Tokyo. This event will be 
held at racecourses all across the 
country!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone with ties to the local community 
will be offering wonderful second 
helpings!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, we are Umamusume, right? When it 
comes to showing gratitude, in the end... 
this is something you just can't skip, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll do my very, very best! P-P-P-Please 
take care of meee!!

text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOOOH!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fill their bellies with piping hot ramen! 
And bring true smiles to their faces with 
a red-hot race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Only by going that far can we deliver what 
we wanted to give everyone—something that 
exceeds expectations!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Now, please, dig in♪" "This is our way of 
'repaying the favor'!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"The Supreme Bowl of Ramen Cup"... The 
Umamusume are in the gates—and now! 
They're all off at once!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up the lead!! I am the 
fastest, haah, haah! *pant* *pant* 
*wheeze*! *gasp* *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're truly gasping for breath, aren't 
ya?! But I'm not showing any mercy! Once 
in a while, even I gotta show off my time 
to shine!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I will... Even I will! Catch up... I'm 
going to catch up to that back!
choice_data_list: (...That's the best kind of "seconds" there is, huh.)
(...That's the best kind of "seconds" there is, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Riding on the heat of the race, it reached 
me clearly. Their feelings... directed 
straight toward their fans.

text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text:
""...Thank you."" ""Thank youuu!"" ""Thank 
you for expressing your gratitude!!""

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah, I see. I think I finally 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ramen is just like racing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Because with both... you can convey what 
you want to say without needing words.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(In racing, with my polished running. In 
ramen, with my unyielding devotion.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I can properly convey every bit of the 
"thank you" overflowing from my heart!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be Fine-chan thought that far 
ahead—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um, Fine-chan! Could you be...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ramen and racing share fundamental 
aspects! You knew that, which is why you 
chose ramen as your way of giving back! Am 
I right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I'm not thinking about anything 
like that~! I just thought ramen could 
bring smiles to all the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?! You're totally right! 
Maybe I was just overthinking things... 
Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However... hehe. That's one way to 
interpret it! Ramen really is so profound.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thought I already knew plenty. But over 
these past three years—I came to know 
even, so much more.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I guess I've fallen for it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I made some great memories! I'm 
so glad I asked to stay behind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Top Road-san. For helping me 
repay this favor together.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! Words aren't enough to describe 
how much fun it was! Ahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fine-chan...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Well then, let's get going. I 
have to live up to everyone's expectations 
right till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thank you so very much for all 
your cheers!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ But you're not satisfied yet, are 
you? After all, usually—a race is followed 
by an "extra serving"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please enjoy♪ A rich and 
punchy—Winning Live!!
